question: Find the top 5 directors who have directed the most movies in the 'Action' genre, along with the count of such movies.
sql: SELECT graph.d, graph.movie_count FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('moivelens', 'MATCH (d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE) WHERE g.name = ''Action'' GROUP BY d RETURN d, COUNT(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 5') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(d VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[0]', movie_count INT PATH '$[1]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('moivelens', 'MATCH (d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE) WHERE g.name = ''Action'' GROUP BY d RETURN d, COUNT(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 5')

question: Retrieve the top 10 actors who have acted in the most movies that are similar to 'Movie Title 1' with a similarity score greater than 0.8. Return the actor names and the count of such movies.
sql: SELECT graph.name, graph.movie_count FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('moivelens', 'MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m1:MOVIE) WHERE m1.title = ''Movie Title 1'' AND s.similarity_score > 0.8 GROUP BY a.name RETURN a.name, COUNT(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 10') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(name VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[0]', movie_count INT PATH '$[1]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('moivelens', 'MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m1:MOVIE) WHERE m1.title = ''Movie Title 1'' AND s.similarity_score > 0.8 GROUP BY a.name RETURN a.name, COUNT(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 10')

question: Find all users who rated movies with a rating value greater than 4 and also tagged at least one movie.
sql: SELECT graph.u FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('moivelens', 'MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING), (u:USER)-[:ASSIGNS]->(t:TAG) WHERE r.rating_value > 4 RETURN DISTINCT u') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(u VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[0]')) AS graph

sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('moivelens', 'MATCH (m:MOVIE)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY {name: ''United Pictures''}), (m)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: ''Sci-Fi''}) RETURN m.title')

sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('moivelens', 'MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[ai:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE) WHERE g.name = ''Sci-Fi'' GROUP BY a.name RETURN a.name, COUNT(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 5')

question: Calculate the average age of users who have rated movies with a similarity score greater than 0.8 with at least one other movie.
sql: SELECT graph.average_age FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('moivelens', 'MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING)<-[:RATES]-(m1:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE) WHERE s.similarity_score > 0.8 RETURN AVG(u.age) AS average_age') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(average_age DOUBLE PATH '$[0]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('moivelens', 'MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING)<-[:RATES]-(m1:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE) WHERE s.similarity_score > 0.8 RETURN AVG(u.age) AS average_age')

sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('moivelens', 'MATCH (m:MOVIE {title: ''Movie Title 1''})-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:ACTOR {name: ''Actor 1''}) RETURN m, a')

sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('moivelens', 'MATCH (m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE), (m)<-[:RATES]-(r:RATING) WHERE g.name = ''Action'' RETURN count(m) AS movie_count')

sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('moivelens', 'MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[ai:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE) GROUP BY a RETURN a, COUNT(DISTINCT m) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT m) DESC')

question: Find all users who are older than 30 and have the occupation 'Engineer', sorted by their age in descending order.
sql: SELECT graph.u FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('moivelens', 'MATCH (u:USER) WHERE u.age > 30 AND u.occupation = ''Engineer'' RETURN u ORDER BY u.age DESC') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(u VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[0]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('moivelens', 'MATCH (u:USER) WHERE u.age > 30 AND u.occupation = ''Engineer'' RETURN u ORDER BY u.age DESC')

question: What is the average rating value given to movies produced by 'Marvel Studios'?
sql: SELECT graph.average_rating FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('moivelens', 'MATCH (pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY {name: ''Marvel Studios''})<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)<-[r:RATES]-(u:USER) RETURN avg(r.rating_value) AS average_rating') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(average_rating DOUBLE PATH '$[0]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('moivelens', 'MATCH (pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY {name: ''Marvel Studios''})<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)<-[r:RATES]-(u:USER) RETURN avg(r.rating_value) AS average_rating')

question: What ratings can be reached from the user with USER_id 123 through the RATES relationship?
sql: SELECT graph.r FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('moivelens', 'MATCH (u:USER {USER_id: 123})-[:RATES]->(r:RATING) RETURN r') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(r VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[0]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('moivelens', 'MATCH (u:USER {USER_id: 123})-[:RATES]->(r:RATING) RETURN r')

question: How many paths exist between users with the occupation 'Engineer' and movies released after 2000 through ratings?
sql: SELECT graph.path_count FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('moivelens', 'MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING)<-[:RATES]-(m:MOVIE) WHERE u.occupation = ''Engineer'' AND m.release_date > ''2000-12-31'' RETURN count(*) AS path_count') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(path_count INT PATH '$[0]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('moivelens', 'MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING)<-[:RATES]-(m:MOVIE) WHERE u.occupation = ''Engineer'' AND m.release_date > ''2000-12-31'' RETURN count(*) AS path_count')
